scenes.title: There is no App Store for local AI
scenes.caption: Every tool is somebody's repo. There is no shelf.
scenes.narration: Cloud AI has one address. Local AI is a thousand repositories, and nobody hands you the list.

scenes.title: Most people quit right about here
scenes.caption: Not because the tools are bad. Because they're invisible.
scenes.narration: So you try the one you heard of, hit a dead README, and stop looking.

scenes.title: Spellbook
scenes.caption: 797 tools across 16 shelves. On your machine, not ours.
scenes.narration: Spellbook is that list. Sixteen shelves, seven hundred and ninety-seven tools, and it runs offline.

scenes.caption: No login, no setup. The shelf is already full.
scenes.narration: Open it and it's already full. No account, no setup, nothing to configure.
